title: D-Day: Allied forces land in Normandy
summary: About 156,000 American, British, Canadian and other Allied troops landed on five beaches in Normandy, supported by paratroopers and thousands of ships and aircraft.
reason: The Allies needed a second front in western Europe to defeat Germany, and had spent years preparing the largest seaborne invasion in history.
significance: It began the liberation of western Europe and sealed Nazi Germany's defeat.
